snippet.title: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails brings naval warfare to Calradia for the first time.

Take command at sea, engage in ship-based combat, and expand your campaign across a new naval frontier.

Watch the accolades trailer for a look at the praise War Sails has received from critics.

A huge thank you to our community for your continued support and feedback. 

Get War Sails now:
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1468-PPSA04136_00-MB2BANNERLORDWS0 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/mount-blade-ii-bannerlord-war-sails/9n205dn89073
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927200/Mount__Blade_II_Bannerlord__War_Sails/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/mount-and-blade-2-mount-and-blade-ii-bannerlord-war-sails-597919
